authority_boundary: Read-only copy and terminology contract only. This copy system cannot approve trades, create candidates, stage orders, submit paper orders, write brokers, send Telegram commands, call live capital, mutate data sources, or change runtime status.

primary_view_copy_policy.default_rule: Use plain operating labels in primary copy. Internal stage codes and implementation labels are diagnostic metadata, not onboarding language.
primary_view_copy_policy.overview_rule: Overview must answer what is happening now without unexplained D-codes, Q-codes, phase-first labels, static-snapshot jargon, secure-bridge jargon, or shadow-toggle jargon.
primary_view_copy_policy.operations_rule: Operations may show internal codes and runtime terms only as labeled diagnostics with a plain explanation beside them.
primary_view_copy_policy.phase_rule: Phase labels are allowed only as secondary diagnostics. Primary labels must use operating-state language.
primary_view_copy_policy.safety_rule: Safety copy must stay explicit: read-only, paper/demo only, live capital disabled, broker writes blocked, and candidate is not an order.

terminology.user_explanation: A static dashboard surface that cannot operate Qadam or call local runtime tools.
The sanitized read-only status payload shown in the browser.
The local store for observed signals and candidate state. It is not an order route.
A source of observed signals only. It cannot trade.
The authenticated browser path that reads Qadam status without command authority.
The strategy approval and visibility workstream.
The paper-only workflow for reviewing, staging, reconciling, and monitoring paper trades.
The closeout work that proved the paper lifecycle before the learning loop.
The review workflow for postmortems and proposed learning updates.
The 30 consecutive calendar day paper proof harness.
Use this for strategy approval state. Show the phase label only as secondary diagnostic metadata.
Use this for paper lifecycle orchestration. Show the phase label only as secondary diagnostic metadata.
Use this for postmortems and learning proposals. Show the phase label only as secondary diagnostic metadata.
Use this for the demo-proof harness. Show the phase label only as secondary diagnostic metadata.
A read-only fallback copy of the latest public-safe status.
The browser can read current status through the bridge, but cannot command Qadam.
A visible strategy mode that cannot create candidates, orders, or broker actions.
Qadam is not allowed to trade real money from this dashboard or paper/demo workflow.
The browser has no route to submit, modify, or close broker orders.
A candidate is a possible trade idea after checks. It is not an order.
A paper-only order draft that still cannot touch live capital.
A paper-account order state, separate from live trading.
An order in the paper account workflow. It is not live capital.

replacement_rules.to: Use the entry's plain label in primary copy. Show the code only in Operations diagnostics with the plain label.

replacement_rules.from: Phase-first labels such as Phase 4 strategy or Q5-14 drill
replacement_rules.to: Lead with the operating state, then include the phase/stage code only as secondary metadata.

replacement_rules.from: static snapshot, secure bridge, shadow toggles
replacement_rules.to: saved status snapshot, read-only live status connection, review-only strategy visibility
Use explicit labels: read-only, paper/demo only, live capital disabled, broker writes blocked, candidate is not an order.

normal_no_setup.title: No qualified setup right now
normal_no_setup.body: Qadam has not found a setup that meets the current source and risk requirements. This is normal when the market is quiet or evidence is incomplete.

normal_no_trade.title: No paper trade right now
normal_no_trade.body: There is no active paper trade. Qadam may still be watching sources, forming hypotheses, or waiting for stronger evidence.

normal_no_position.title: No open paper position
normal_no_position.body: The paper account has no open position in the current snapshot.

normal_no_postmortem.title: No postmortem due
normal_no_postmortem.body: There is no closed paper trade waiting for review.

blocked.title: Action blocked
blocked.body: Qadam is blocked by a safety, source, risk, or approval rule. The dashboard remains read-only and cannot bypass the block.

stale.title: Status may be stale
stale.body: The latest status is older than expected. Treat the readout as informational until the status refreshes.

degraded.title: Some inputs are degraded
degraded.body: One or more feeds, models, or runtime checks are unavailable. Qadam should reduce confidence until the degraded input recovers.

missing.title: Status unavailable
missing.body: The dashboard has no public-safe status for this panel yet. This does not create trading authority.
